purpose: Teach: 壷/林道/極楽/大昔/甘み/グリル/シェイクスピア/大黒

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、立派な壷あるな
lines.en: Riku, you've got some seriously nice vases at your place.
lines.style: Light, teasing observation. Drawl it slightly—knowing she's caught him out. Casual lean-in tone, almost amused at the formality of his home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、林道でジョギングしてんだろ?桜
lines.en: You're the one out jogging on forest trails, aren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Gentle turn-it-back-on-her energy. Softer than she expects. Not defensive—just quietly catching her in her own habits. Slight smile under the surface.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、放課後にゲームやって極楽だな
lines.en: Riku, you get pure bliss from gaming right after school, don't you?
lines.style: Wry, knowing smirk. Drag the word 'bliss' just slightly—making it clear she's exaggerating for effect, but warmly. Testing whether he'll bite.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で大昔の文明やったろ?桜
lines.en: And you studied ancient civilizations in social studies, remember? That's you.
lines.style: Fast counter-volley, not unkind. Playful mirror-image of his own deflection. Eyes bright—she's enjoying this back-and-forth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、甘み控えめのお菓子好きだろ?
lines.en: Riku, you like your snacks on the less-sweet side, don't you?
lines.style: Softer now, genuine curiosity breaking through the banter. Real observation, not teasing. Slight lift at the end—actually asking, not jabbing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家族でグリル料理楽しんだろ?桜
lines.en: Your family has fun grilling together, doesn't it, Sakura?
lines.style: Quieter, more sincere. The jabs stop here. He's noticed something real about her and is saying it plainly. Small hesitation before 'fun'—vulnerable territory.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、文化祭でシェイクスピアの劇やったろ?
lines.en: Didn't your school do that Shakespeare play at the culture festival?
lines.style: Soft, almost gentle question. Not quite meeting her eyes. Acknowledging she's in things that matter. The rhythm is slower, more careful.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前ん家、お父さん大黒柱だろ?桜
lines.en: Your father's the backbone of your family, isn't he, Sakura?
lines.style: Very quiet now. Direct but tender. The question lands like a real moment between them. Slight breathiness on 'backbone'—he means it.
